effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: three layers of soft violet orbs drifting in the dark under one haloed light, in one fragment pass through the HDR tail. Every later effect starts from this shape.

useCases: The template for new effects; a dark ambient hero at a pinch

effects.title: Lens model
effects.summary: A night street through a camera lens: two rows of lamps and a railing of small lights receding from half a metre to six hundred, each drawn as the aperture at its own circle of confusion, while the focus walks through them. Every point keeps its light as it blurs; switch that off to see why it matters.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the street in focus at mid-distance.
useCases: Seeing the lens model and the aperture shapes; a building block, not an effect to ship

effects.title: Depth-of-field lab
effects.summary: One night shot, the depth-of-field methods a real-time renderer uses, and the truth they are scored against: the same shot traced through the whole lens, ray by ray, sharpening over a few seconds. Split, difference and sharp views; drag the split with the pointer.

scorecard.fallback: Stills of each method beside the reference.
useCases: Choosing a depth-of-field method; a research tool, not an effect to ship

effects.title: Aperture lab
effects.summary: Every aperture shape and aberration side by side in time: a grid of lights far behind the focus and a row close in front of it, all drawn through one lens whose aperture the pointer chooses, left to right, and whose f-number it sets, top to bottom. Odd blade counts show the near row flipped.

scorecard.fallback: A contact sheet of the apertures.
useCases: Choosing an aperture for another effect; the page the notes link to

effects.title: Bokeh drift
effects.summary: Points of light far behind a lens focused close: a field of soft violet discs at many depths, drifting upwards under one bright light in haze. Each disc is the aperture at its own circle of confusion and keeps the light of the point it came from, so overlaps add up as they do in a photograph. The pointer shifts them by depth.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the orbs; a CSS version with radial gradients comes close (plan story 7.4).
useCases: A dark hero or section background that moves without asking for attention
Night, music, nightlife and event sites

effects.title: Dust in light
effects.summary: A shaft of sunlight slanting through a dark room towards the lens, and the dust drifting in it: motes light up only inside the beam, sharp where it crosses the plane of focus and soft discs where it comes close to the lens. The beam itself glows with the light the air scatters.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the beam and the dust.
useCases: A quiet, cinematic hero for editorial, architecture and interior sites

effects.title: Fairy lights
effects.summary: Strings of small bulbs hanging in sagging curves across the frame at several depths, behind a lens focused close: every bulb is a soft disc, swaying with its string and twinkling on a signal capped below the flash threshold.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the strings; a CSS version of a few rows of soft dots is close.

effects.title: Fireflies
effects.summary: Fireflies over a meadow at dusk, wandering in depth and each glowing on its own slow rhythm, through a fast lens: the few near the plane of focus are sharp points, the rest soft discs that swell as they drift towards the lens. Move the pointer up and down to move the plane of focus through them.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the meadow with the fireflies glowing.
useCases: A calm evening hero for nature, outdoor and wellness sites

effects.title: Glitter
effects.summary: A sheet of glitter receding from the lens, its thousands of tiny facets each tilted its own way: a facet flashes only when it mirrors the light into the lens, so a moving light sends a ripple of sparks across it, sharp where the sheet is in focus and soft discs where it is not.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the sheet with a band of sparks.
useCases: Fashion, beauty, celebration and jewellery heroes

effects.title: Night street
effects.summary: A city street at night through a fast lens focused close: oncoming headlights and receding tail lights in two lanes, rows of sodium lamps, clusters of neon and slow traffic lights, every one a soft disc of its own colour. Move the pointer up and down to pull the focus from near to far.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the street; a looped video does the plain version well.
useCases: A night-time hero for city, travel, music and nightlife sites

effects.title: Snow at night
effects.summary: Snow falling past a street lamp in a little fog, seen through a lens focused a few metres out: flakes near the lamp catch its light, far ones are specks, and the ones that pass close to the lens are huge faint discs drifting across the frame.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the lamp and the falling snow.
useCases: A winter hero or seasonal section

effects.title: Focus cursor
effects.summary: A field of floating lanterns from two metres to sixty, and a lens whose focus follows the pointer: whatever lantern you point at comes sharp, the rest melt into discs, and the focus racks between them the way a camera’s does. Without a pointer it wanders on its own.

scorecard.fallback: A still with the focus mid-field; the rack needs the shader.
useCases: A hero that answers the pointer without asking for a click
